title: Black Light FTL Installation Safety Timing and Readiness Registry
purpose: Translate installation sensor, control, actuation, maintenance, recovery, common-cause and sectional-topology evidence into provenance-bearing timing modifiers without inventing canonical seconds, family identity, race coefficients, or independent failure probabilities.

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Predictive sensing, emergency de-transit, family-specific safety margins, machinery failure sensitivity, and the principle that technological maturity lowers risk without abolishing it.

integration.flow: Baseline route timing -> sectional service topology -> channel readiness and current path latency -> common-cause transient degradation -> readiness timing scaling -> excess sectional reroute latency -> family/route certification.
integration.blockingRule: Blocked readiness, hard declared limits and conflicting authority stop certification. Missing certified sectional latency baselines do not authorize adding the full current latency, because nominal path delay may already be included in baseline stage timing.

mathematicalModel.baselineIntervention: t_int,0 = t_sensor + t_solver + t_decision + t_command + t_actuate + t_exit + t_clear + t_margin
mathematicalModel.lookaheadScaling: t_prediction = t_prediction,0 * r_sensor * r_navigation * r_reference / m_prediction
mathematicalModel.coupledDeficit: d_i,eff = max(d_i, max_k(c_ki*s_k)); r_i,eff = 1-d_i,eff under deterministic MAX_ENVELOPE
mathematicalModel.kOfNLatency: for a k-of-n safety group, completion latency is the kth-smallest finite latency among eligible members
mathematicalModel.baselineMissingRule: If tau_i,certifiedBaseline is unknown, Delta_tau_i remains unresolved; do not substitute zero and do not add the full current path latency automatically.
mathematicalModel.continuousMargin: M_T = D_B/v_progress - t_int for continuous projected-progress families where v_progress has authoritative route-progress semantics
mathematicalModel.precommitMargin: M_T = t_prediction - t_int for PRECOMMIT families; no intermediate local FTL velocity may be fabricated
mathematicalModel.interpretation: Readiness changes ability to observe, decide, actuate and recover. Sectional latency changes how long those actions take when service paths reroute. Neither alters G, the external tidal tensor or the selected family's physical equations.

records.timingPolicy: Use route-safety baseline timing unchanged when no narrower sourced record exists. Measured condition, common-cause transients and certified sectional reroute evidence may only preserve or worsen the baseline unless a narrower authority explicitly certifies improvement.

runtimeRules: Narrower matching scope outranks broader scope; equal-precedence contradictions return CONFLICT rather than averaging.
UNRESOLVED named records preserve evidence but do not create numeric timing modifiers.
Measured readiness may only worsen or preserve a baseline unless a sourced record explicitly certifies improvement.
Sectional topology is resolved before common-cause degradation so physically disconnected services cannot masquerade as healthy.
Common-cause transient resolution occurs before readiness timing scaling.
Current sectional group latency is preserved as evidence even when a certified baseline is missing.
Only Delta_tau=max(0,tau_current-tau_certifiedBaseline) is added to a timing stage when both values are known.
Never assume a missing certified sectional latency baseline is zero; that would double-count nominal path delay already embedded in baseline timing.
The default common-cause aggregation is deterministic MAX_ENVELOPE, not independent failure-probability multiplication.
A zero or negative readiness channel is blocking, not a division-by-zero workaround.
Maintenance state and sectional routing affect timing/readiness; they do not change external gravity or family identity.
Named technology, vessel, installation, manufacturer or race identity is never a family selector.
PRECOMMIT families remain timing-based and may not be assigned a fabricated local transit velocity.
Protected recovery reserve may not be consumed to improve advertised nominal timing.
Adjusted packets preserve baselineTiming, baselineRecovery, coupledDegradation, sectionalLatency, factors, source record IDs and provenance.
canonGuards: No absolute timing number, sectional baseline or coupling coefficient is historical/universal canon unless a named source explicitly establishes it.
The Ar'nock record establishes solid-state modular machinery constraints but not an FTL family or canonical timing performance.
Bioprinting is not evidence for biological Ar'nock computation, propulsion or control machinery.
The Mur'rek record establishes machinery dependencies but not a normalized FTL family or canonical timing in seconds.
Sectional availability and latency are deterministic engineering state, not failure probability.
Readiness/common-cause equations are engineering models, not evidence that a fictional hazard exists.
Race/species identity constrains machinery embodiment but may not create family, manufacturer or performance canon.
Simulation calibration remains labeled PROPOSED or DERIVED as applicable.
